milestones.name: Account Recovery
milestones.user_story: As a registered member, I want to reset a forgotten password so that I can get back in without support.

tasks.description: Implement the confirm endpoint that redeems a reset token and sets the new password.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /v1/password-resets/{token} with a token issued 31 minutes earlier returns HTTP 410 with error token-expired and leaves the password hash unchanged.
A second redemption of a token that already changed the password returns HTTP 410, even within 30 minutes.
